action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    if not all(isinstance(x, np.ndarray) for x in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("input shapes must match")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("inputs cannot be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all():
        raise ValueError("inputs must be finite")
    if not (np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) and np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) and np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    n, H = logp_with_result.shape
    t = np.arange(H, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    L_plus = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = (margin >= tau_filter)
    return keep, margin
